items.title: 2nd or 3rd Startup Conversation
items.hook: "what's the smallest thing I could implement?"
items.description:
2026-08-23, 6:26pm.
Worked out basic things that the Today cockpit focuses on: Orientation, Direction, Operations, and Witness.  And then we talked about minimal implementation.  This turned into a basic framing for the app.
